data.one_liner: Plugin to read managed app configurations provided by mobile device management (MDM).
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to read managed app configurations supplied by a Mobile Device Management (MDM) provider. It provides methods to fetch the configuration and a stream to listen for configuration changes, as well as reporting app states on Android.
use_when: You need to read MDM-managed app configurations on Android, iOS, or macOS.
Your app needs to react to changes in managed configurations via a stream.
avoid_when: You do not use an MDM provider for enterprise configuration.
You only need standard local key-value storage without MDM integration.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and macOS platforms.
Provides both a one-time fetch method and a reactive stream for configuration changes.
Supports reporting state via KeyedAppStatesReporter on Android.
weaknesses: Testing on iOS and macOS requires an actual MDM provider since Apple does not provide a local development environment.
Limited to reading managed app configurations and reporting states.
data.setup_notes: Requires testing setup using an MDM provider (such as Relution for iOS/macOS) or TestDPC for Android.
